### Problem

The engine spends most of its model use testing itself, not working. In the 24 hours to 2026-11-22 04:00 UTC, of the model minutes of every AI job in DiluxOne/.github and DiluxOne/diluxone-test, the AI evaluation (evals.yml: whole autopilot and Spec replays with Opus) took 65% (2,721 min, 180 jobs) and the review evaluation (review-eval.yml: 3 plays of 20 reviews) 21% (888 min, 45 jobs), while the autopilot's real work on issues took 8% (351 min). Both evaluations run on every push to any pull request that touches an AI step's paths, including a push that only merges main: #925's ran 7 times, #930's 5. A Max subscription's 5-hour limit was spent in about an hour.

### Scope

- evals.yml and review-eval.yml no longer run on pull requests; they run once a week on main and by hand (workflow_dispatch).
- The autopilot's replay runs one fix round, not the production's `autopilot-rounds` (5).
- Tests and docs in step.

### Out of scope

- What the evaluations check, their sets and baselines.
- The release lane, which stays after every merge to main: it spends little, since its autopilot calls no model.
- The review of each pull request.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given a pull request that touches an AI step's paths, when it is pushed, then neither evals.yml nor review-eval.yml starts.
- C2: Given an autopilot case of the evaluation whose review blocks, when it is replayed, then it runs one fix round and is graded.

### Criticality

Critical
